description: With the app of the city of Merano (South Tyrol, Italy) you always get up-to-date information on events,  hotels and accommodations, bike tours, hiking trails,  a gastronomy guide and much more. Discover Merano, its extensive parks and green promenades at any time of the year. The diverse cultural offerings range from the Merano Spring to the traditional "Traubenfest" and the Merano Christmas Markets, up to the Südtirol Festival Merano to the Merano WineFestival. Use your AI tool to plan your holiday at MeranO.
